instruction: Open-choice GUI requirement: This environment provides three candidate engineering applications, including BIM-capable applications and a distractor application. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable application yourself, then complete the task entirely through that application's graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, macros, external API automation, Python, shell, IfcOpenShell, scripts, or any helper code that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only native BIM GUI tools, menus, dialogs, model views, properties, room/zone/space tools, available library or family objects, and built-in IFC export or Save As IFC commands. Split Open Studio into Two Rooms. Start from the provided init.ifc by opening it in the selected BIM application. The init model is a relevant but incomplete predecessor; clean, complete, rename, subdivide, or add BIM elements as requested instead of replacing it with unrelated geometry. Build or edit the model using real BIM elements such as Walls, Slabs, Zones, Doors, Windows, Roofs, and Stairs where required; use real BIM elements rather than visual-only detail geometry where the task requires model elements. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using the selected BIM application's built-in IFC export or Save As IFC workflow. Export the complete model as IFC4 and include the Zones/Spaces in the export. The init model contains one large Zone named OPEN STUDIO. Split it with a real internal wall into two Zones named STUDIO and MEETING, and provide doors and windows appropriate for the two rooms. The exported IFC should contain Zones exported as IfcSpace entries named STUDIO, MEETING. It should contain at least 1 building storey, at least 2 IfcSpace zones, at least 5 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, at least 1 IfcSlab element, at least 2 IfcDoor elements, at least 2 IfcWindow elements. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching X span 8 m, Y span 4 m, and Z span 3 m. The IFC should have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects. Other exact coordinates, room proportions, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, library part names, property sets, layers, relationship nesting, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved result.ifc satisfies the stated BIM content.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
